issues.title: Android 12.05: Conflict resolution experience
issues.review_roles: Android storage/sync reviewer and service owner for enabled remote paths
acceptance_criteria: Preserve both revisions, explain divergence and offer explicit merge/fork/retry choices; never silently overwrite newer work.
A conflict preserves both versions and exposes no default action that silently overwrites the newer remote head.
Resolution either produces a valid authorized new revision/fork or leaves the conflict intact; concurrent new remote edits cause fresh reconciliation.
Unresolved conflicts and unsent local edits remain recoverable after process death and account/auth transitions.
implementation_steps: Retain local pending content and authoritative remote head when CAS detects divergence, recording their common base where available.
Show a comprehensible selection/settings/lock diff and explain which changes can be merged safely versus requiring an explicit choice.
Offer approved keep-remote, fork-local or explicit merge/retry actions, generating a new valid revision/operation without rewriting either retained source.
Persist unresolved conflict state across recreation and revalidate authorization and current remote head before applying a resolution.
issues.validation:
